rules.condition: SLO error budget burn rate exceeds 14.4x in 1h or 6.0x in 6h window
rules.automated_response: Trigger P1/P2 incident creation in Incident Manager and page on-call SRE

rules.condition: Service 30-day rolling error budget consumed reaches 100.0%
rules.automated_response: Automatically engage CI/CD deployment block for non-remediation changes

rules.condition: Post-deployment canary SLO error rate degrades > 0.5% compared to baseline
rules.automated_response: Issue automated traffic abort and trigger rollback pipeline

rules.condition: Document processing queue depth exceeds 5,000 items with worker saturation > 90%
rules.automated_response: Trigger autoscaling event to provision additional OCR/LLM worker replicas
